# Quantitative HCI Liquid Glass

> Agent-first behaviours, visual components and design tools built on Vercel UI SDK. React rendering; @ui-sdk/core and @ui-sdk/react pinned to 0.1.0-beta.13. Custom work remains Unvalidated by a human UI/UX team.

## Start here

- [Engineering guide](agent-engineering.md): choose, compose, extend, operate and verify.
- [Package guide](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/README.md): provider, material and component recipes.
- [Package instructions](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/AGENTS.md): requirements for future package changes.
- [Compact component index](/agent-index.json): choose by purpose, kind and public export; follow its `contract` URL for one complete entry.
- [Agent contracts](/agent-contracts.json): public export inventory, inputs, state, discovery, actions, restrictions and evidence.
- [Contract schema](/agent-contracts.schema.json): the versioned machine-readable contract format.

## Choose a component

- [Models and transactions](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/src/modeling/README.md): inspect, preview, revision-checked edits, controlled acceptance and history.
- [Agent tasks](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/src/agents/README.md): capabilities, timeline, tool review, context and artifacts; local component schema, not protocol transport.
- [Graphics](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/src/graphics/README.md): layers, transforms, exports and host-owned image requests.
- [Package guide: Standards, shared canvas and images](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/packages/liquid-glass/README.md): composition and appearance APIs.
- [Modeling architecture](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/docs/hci/standards/agent-first-modeling.md): shared document, UWE/C4 scope and evaluation.
- [Engineering standard](https://github.com/45ck/hci-review-skill/blob/main/docs/hci/standards/agent-engineering.md): required evidence and future additions.

## Installed upstream authority

Read node_modules/@ui-sdk/core/skills/ui-sdk/SKILL.md and node_modules/@ui-sdk/react/docs/llms.txt first. Open only the needed component, rendering, agent and testing pages. Use installed declaration files to resolve exact types. Import SDK controls directly from @ui-sdk/react/<component>; never @ui-sdk/core/internal/*.

For a local checkout, the registry and schema sit at packages/liquid-glass/agent-contracts.json and packages/liquid-glass/agent-contracts.schema.json. Their hosted copies are served at the root paths above. Resolve source/docs/evidence paths in registry entries from the repository root, not from the hosted URL.

Read only the contract needed: `npm run glass:contract -- --search viewport`, then `npm run glass:contract -- liquid-viewport`. Hosted consumers can fetch `/contracts/liquid-viewport.json`. The full registry is available for tooling; it need not be loaded into every agent conversation.

The runtime is createAgent from @ui-sdk/react/agent: snapshot, query, act and subscribe. Contracts describe intended use; only executed tests establish that the described behaviour works. See the engineering guide for observable postconditions and limitations.
